symptom: After failed activation cleanup cleared the transition, a later prepared workspace Stop left its activation's proof on an older generation. Strict rollback remained impossible even after the provider stopped the VM.
rule: Retain the current recovery receipt across subsequent lifecycle completions. A stale stopped receipt needs a fresh provider-confirmed Stop, never a weaker rollback predicate or a runner-side row repair (principles 1, 4, 5 and 13).
